title: NANPA authority for shard-A NPAs 840, 843, 858 and 864

data.notes: Current numbering-plan materials identify 840 (California 909 overlay geography), 843 (South Carolina Lowcountry/coast), 858 (California San Diego 619 overlay geography), and 864 (South Carolina Upstate, overlaid by 821) as in-service U.S. geographic NPAs. Each satisfies integer(NPA) mod 3 == 0.

title: Inland Empire ABCF current federation directory

data.notes: Current ABCF contact directory lists Inland Empire ABCF at Upland, California and provides a public organizational contact address. Upland lies in the 909/840 overlay geography.

Current first-party site describes Mutual Rise as an Inland Empire community-centered organization providing free meals, groceries, hygiene kits and essentials, explicitly framing its work as solidarity and shared responsibility rather than charity.

title: Inland Empire Anarchist Book Fair 2026 current listing

data.notes: Current 2026 Southern California zine-fair calendar lists the Inland Empire Anarchist Book Fair in San Bernardino with the public handle @ieanarchistbookfair, corroborating continued public organizing activity in the 909/840 geography.

title: Charleston Food Not Bombs current distribution profile

data.notes: Current Charleston DSA support page describes Food Not Bombs as a North Charleston collective distributing food and supplies every Sunday; WhyHunger independently lists Charleston Food Not Bombs and its public Instagram handle foodnotbombscharleston.

title: Lowcountry Action Committee current first-party site

data.notes: Current first-party site identifies LAC as a Black-led grassroots organization dedicated to Black liberation through service, political education and collective action in Charleston/North Charleston, with an active Freedom Bag community-support program and an official branch relationship to NAARPR.

title: Mutual Aid San Diego current first-party network site

data.notes: Current first-party network site describes mutual aid as solidarity rather than charity and maintains public San Diego mutual-aid updates and resource coordination; a 2025 first-party post documents continuing network activity and community resource exchange.

title: General Strike San Diego current 2026 profile

data.notes: August 11, 2026 profile states General Strike San Diego began in summer 2025, meets monthly, coordinates publicly through Discord and is a San Diego chapter of General Strike U.S. participating in A Radical Guide's Financial Solidarity Project.

title: Upstate Food Not Bombs current Greenville listing

data.notes: Current Greenville outreach page states Upstate Food Not Bombs distributes food and essential supplies every Monday in Greenville; LiveWell Greenville also lists the group as a current free-meal resource with its public Facebook surface.

title: GVL SC Mask Bloc current first-party site

data.notes: Current first-party site identifies Greenville SC Mask Bloc as a mutual-aid organization distributing free masks and COVID resources in Greenville and exposes public Facebook, X, Reddit, Instagram and Bluesky communication surfaces.
